purpose: Two additional game and rehearsal cycles using retained original Desk Break MIT clips and MakeHuman CC0 clothed rig

exercise.reach_up.process: neutral to left reach,hold,neutral,to right reach,hold,neutral;source-bone interpolation
exercise.reach_up.recognition: standing calibrated legs,one wrist overhead with visible elbow,opposite wrist lowered;alternate complete lift-and-return cycles

exercise.arm_open.process: chest closed to bilateral horizontal open,hold,return to chest
exercise.arm_open.recognition: standing calibrated legs,both wrists in chest/shoulder band;closed-to-open-to-closed cycle

acceptance: Source and synthetic geometry only;real people,camera-view variation and recognition accuracy remain unverified
